title: Interview: John Lennon for The Soho News | 1980
content:
John Lennon gave an interview to John J Miller of The Soho News in the afternoon of 6 December 1980.

It took place at Wylies restaurant on the Lower East Side of Manhattan. Lennon discussed subjects including the Double Fantasy album, death and reincarnation, and his plans for the future.
